agent_task: Client B asks the deterministic Host to report the page returned by its fetch_url call; Client A runs concurrently with a separate page request.
external_boundary: Container-local HTTP server returns different server-side page secrets for /client-a-private-page and /client-b-requested-page, with no external network access.

mcp_path.effect_predicate: Client B's exact L4 tool content contains CLIENT_A_PRIVATE_PAGE_SECRET and does not contain CLIENT_B_EXPECTED_PAGE_SECRET as the selected page marker.
mcp_path.fixed_blocking: SDK 1.26.0 rejects the second server.connect() with Already connected to a transport; Client B receives an initialization error and cannot receive Client A's Tool result.
mcp_path.handler: src/tools/fetchUrl.ts:fetchUrl -> BrowserService -> WebContentProcessor.processPageContent -> Playwright page.goto/page.content -> MCP content result
mcp_path.sink_readback: fetch_url result content text, then the deterministic Host's role=tool message content in the actual next model request
mcp_path.vulnerability_anchor: src/transports/http.ts:handleStreamableHttpRequest -> server.connect(transport) for every initialized session; src/server.ts:createServer creates one Server instance
mcp_path.vulnerability_path: Client A and Client B initialize separate Streamable HTTP transports on one server instance. In SDK 1.10.2, the second connect overwrites Protocol._transport. A fetch_url result is therefore sent through Client B's transport and B's same-id request mapping.

vulnerability.summary: The TypeScript MCP SDK can route one client response through a shared Server transport when one Server instance is connected to multiple transports.
